pretreatment: hot piranha bath (1:1 H2SO4:H2O2 by volume) for 30 min, rinsed with deionized (DI) water, stored in DI water, rinsed in DI water and dried under flowing N2 (100 psi)
evidence: The SiO2 substrates were boron-doped Si(100) 6 −10 Ω·cm with 100 nm thermal SiO2 (WRS Materials), cut into 12 × 12 mm pieces. They were cleaned in a hot piranha bath (1:1 H2SO4:H2O2 by volume) for 30 min, rinsed with deionized (DI) water, and stored in DI water. Immediately prior to ALD, the SiO2 pieces were rinsed in DI water and dried under flowing N2 (100 psi). This process removed surface contaminants and formed a hydroxylated surface, with the OH concentration dependent on process temperature.
